g.text: Read the head commit of the worktree
Author is the bot of the
Head commit of the pull request
equals the head of the worktree?
(stop-note.md, one sentence for the failed check)
Retry, then hand it back to the Owner
(the next implementation issue of this requirement)
Hand back to the Owner (the row number is an argument)
One failure does not stop the next step.
Nothing is rolled back. Failures are logged.
(the link is the comment; a setting can turn it off)
